HG-ha/Argusai.description: One person, a whole AI security team. ArgusAI integrates autonomous agents, multi-agent collaboration, penetration testing, real-time MITM, mobile and binary reverse engineering, browser and desktop control, from a single sentence stating the goal through planning, execution, verification, and delivery.
HG-ha/Argusai.body:
Local workbench · Long-running autonomous execution · Proactive protection · Continuous offense and defense

## Agent Runs Throughout the Workbench

ArgusAI is an Agent-native security workbench open-sourced by [Dawa Technology](https://dawahezhi.com/). It places an AI assistant, scanning tasks, browser, proxy traffic, reverse-engineering samples, and evidence into a single local workspace, targeting intranet security protection, application security protection, attack tracing, and continuous offense and defense. It supports everything from organizing goals and materials through controlled verification, reporting, and remediation retesting.

Hand over goals, materials, and authorized scope to the Agent, and it coordinates scanning, browser, proxy, reverse engineering, knowledge management, and scheduled tasks, continuously advancing analysis, verification, and delivery. The Agent is the default entry point for work; the feature pages are for observing progress, reviewing evidence, and stepping in when needed. The GUI, CLI, and Python kernel connect to the same set of working capabilities.

The full conversation in the sidebar and the draggable floating ball are both task entry points, and both lead to the same Agent workspace. The Agent can understand the current application page, the task or reverse-engineering job you are viewing, and related work status. Once you reference specific materials, it can continue with the work you are doing. Feature pages and conversations share tasks, samples, and evidence.

The project is aimed at enterprise security teams, application security engineers, security researchers, and explicitly authorized testers. The underlying Agent runtime also supports file processing, everyday information organization, and desktop collaboration; the currently built-in tools and workflows focus mainly on security analysis and reverse-engineering research.

## One Workspace, Connecting Analysis and Execution

From the full conversation or the floating ball, describe a goal, for example "Continue the current application audit, refine the plan, advance analysis within the authorized scope, and save the evidence." The Agent organizes tool execution around the current task. You can open the relevant feature pages to view progress and results, and when more material is needed, drag files from the sandbox onto the floating ball to bring references into the conversation and keep working.

Built-in checks, skill workflows, and external tool integrations each handle different stages. For inputs, dependencies, and usage steps of specific features, see the [Wiki User Manual](https://github.com/HG-ha/Argusai/blob/HEAD/wiki/Home.md).

## Continuous Execution and Proactive Discovery

### Autonomous Single-Turn Execution Lasting Tens of Hours

ArgusAI supports autonomous single-turn execution lasting tens of hours. "Single turn" here refers to multiple consecutive model and tool calls within one user task, not a single HTTP or model request. The runtime has no fixed cap on model/tool rounds. The default single-turn emergency time limit is 7 days, and it retains progress checks, infinite-loop detection, cancellation, and deadline mechanisms.

This is a capability provided by runtime configuration and control flow; actual duration is subject to the task, model quota, tools, resources, and authorization limits. Long investigations, sample batch analysis, and multi-stage verification can keep advancing within the same turn. Work that needs to continue across turns, or when the next event occurs, is carried on by persistent tasks and the scheduler.

### Cross-Turn Resumption and Event-Driven Execution

The Agent saves progress as to-dos, checkpoints, knowledge, and artifacts, and the scheduler picks up the work on subsequent triggers.

Illusory-moon/bot-mindscape.body:
# bot-mindscape · 心灵景观

> **A general-purpose enhancement framework across four layers: cognition, expression, immersion, and awakening.** It cures goldfish memory, the text-machine feel, mechanical immersion-breaking, and being unresponsive until called.

> **“Tell me one thing that impressed you most three days ago”**
> It can answer, and the answer is **that specific thing**, not a generic pleasantry.

**Other languages:** [English](https://github.com/Illusory-moon/bot-mindscape/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md)

---

## Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Illusory-moon/bot-mindscape.git
cd bot-mindscape
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp config/config.example.yaml config/config.yaml
# Edit config.yaml and fill in your bot info
python scripts/run_selfcheck.py    # Self-check the environment (including the redaction scan)
python scripts/config_gui.py       # Generate config
python scripts/build_plugin.py --market   # Build a single-file plugin (required before installing into AstrBot)
```

> **Two management interfaces to choose from:**
> - Desktop: `python scripts/config_gui.py` (tkinter, standard library only)
>   ⚠️ You still need `pip install -r requirements.txt` (PyYAML etc.). “No extra GUI library needed” means tkinter is part of the standard library ✓
> - Web: on Windows, double-click `open_dashboard.bat`, which automatically starts the admin console and opens a browser. You can also run `python scripts/web_ui.py` and visit http://127.0.0.1:8777
> (When you double-click `open_dashboard.bat`, it automatically picks a free port between **8777–8787**. Check the browser it opens for the actual address ✓)
>
> For how each layer connects to the bot framework, see the [Deployment Guide](https://github.com/Illusory-moon/bot-mindscape/blob/HEAD/docs/deploy.md).

If you want the bot to form its own brief impression of the current speaker during conversation, you can separately install the [personal impression plugin](https://github.com/Illusory-moon/astrbot_plugin_impression). It is off by default and isolated per bot and per speaker; and with mindscape…

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios

Pre-match waiting, BP presentation, match opening, in-game HUD, halftime stats, and post-match results: Mizar reads game progress through GSI and combines it with tournament materials to automatically advance the program and switch OBS scenes. Fewer repetitive actions, more energy left for the match.

When on-the-spot adjustments are needed, take over manually at any time. You decide when to resume automation.

_Bans, picks, and the decider map are presented in sequence, so viewers can follow both teams' map arrangements. [View static image](https://github.com/Starfie1d1272/Mizar/blob/HEAD/docs/screenshots/program-veto.png)._

## See the match, and also control the broadcast

In the Windows production workstation, view live CS2 footage, the large radar, and match materials at the same time. Commentators can grasp the overall picture more easily, and directors can confirm on-site conditions through periodic OBS picture previews, stream status, and Bilibili live-broadcast status.

## From the first frame to the final score, one consistent style

The default **Mizar Pulse** packaging runs through pre-match, in-game, and post-match. Four other HUD styles reference the visuals of EWC, IEM, Perfect World, and ESL tournaments.

XBsleepy/daily-agent-benchmarks.body:
# Daily Agent Benchmarks

**Live site: https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/** · [Archive](https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/archive.html) · [Atom feed](https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/feed.xml)

A daily, searchable list of new **AI / LLM agent benchmarks** on arXiv — web agents, GUI & computer-use agents, coding / SWE agents, tool use, multi-agent, embodied, and agent safety evaluations. Each paper gets a page with authors, abstract, field, citation count, and arXiv PDF / HTML links. Updated automatically every day via GitHub Actions.

Collects **Agent Benchmark** papers from [arXiv](https://arxiv.org) every day and organizes them into a static site that can be deployed to GitHub Pages.

The site displays entries in reverse order of submission date: name, authors, abstract, category, and PDF / HTML links. Each day has a bilingual Chinese–English briefing. Search is ranked in the browser using **BM25**.

## What this repository does

1. **Runs once a day** (GitHub Actions, or manually run locally) and calls the arXiv API.
2. **Keeps only Agent Benchmarks**: first retrieves candidates with agent + benchmark–related queries, then filters them with keyword scoring (LLM agent, web/GUI/coding agent, tool-use, computer-use, etc.). Ordinary RL agents, reagent / pathogen, and other unrelated uses are not included.
3. **Merges into the index** `docs/data/index.json`, grouped by `published` date.
4. **Generates the daily briefing** (no paid model required): topic statistics plus the first sentence of the abstract of high-scoring papers, one each in Chinese and English.
5. **GitHub Pages** reads this JSON to render the page. Search runs in the browser and does not depend on a backend.

# Gitee Ai - JMeter Agent

[English](https://github.com/azhengzz/JMeter-AI-Agent-Plugin/blob/HEAD/README_en.md) | Chinese

Gitee Ai is a JMeter AI assistant plugin: describe what you need in natural language, and the AI creates, modifies, runs, and troubleshoots test plans directly in your test plan tree.

## Core Features

- **Generate a test plan from one sentence** — Describe your requirement (e.g. '10 threads sending GET requests to an endpoint and validating the response code'), and the AI creates thread groups, samplers, assertions, and timers directly in the tree, with no manual form-filling
- **Directly manipulate the test plan tree** — Add, edit, delete, move, copy, and batch enable/disable elements, with changes visible instantly; you can also have the AI analyze an existing plan and troubleshoot issues
- **Automatic parameter validation** — Parameter Schemas for 73 JMeter components. Wrong property names, types, or value ranges are reported immediately, without waiting for runtime
- **Test execution is also handled by AI** — Start/stop tests and read live status and results (response time, throughput, error rate). Assertion failure details are automatically exposed to the AI for troubleshooting
- **Choose from 8 model providers, DeepSeek works out of the box** — Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM, Moonshot Kimi, MiniMax, LangCat, and local Ollama
- **Selection linkage** — The chat panel shows in real time which element you have selected in JMeter, and you can inject it into the AI context with one click
- **Cross-session memory** — Remembers your preferences and past actions, and is automatically archived when JMeter closes
- **Safety guardrails** — File access allowlist, SSRF protection, and dangerous command blocking

## Quick Start

For **JMeter 5.6.3 + JDK 17 or later**.

Go to the [Releases](https://github.com/azhengzz/JMeter-Agent/releases) page and download the two attachments from the latest version:

chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor.description: Hong Kong Immigration Department smart ID card appointment quota monitoring dashboard: detection every 5 minutes, with email/Feishu notifications when slots are released (third-party tool, not official)
chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor.body:
# HKID Appointment Quota Dashboard

Monitors smart ID card appointment quotas at the six Immigration Department registration offices in Hong Kong, checking roughly every 2 minutes, and alerts subscribers via email / Feishu group when slots are released. **A third-party public-interest tool, not an official Immigration Department service. It only monitors and sends alerts; it does not grab or book appointments on anyone's behalf.**

## Dashboard entry

- **Preferred (stable direct access from mainland China):** https://hkid-quota-monitor.pages.dev/
- Backup: https://chen1111-a.github.io/hkid-quota-monitor/
  (github.io is intermittently unreachable from mainland networks; jsDelivr/raw direct links carry a nosniff header and only display source code, so don't use them as web entry points)
- The full experience in mainland China without a VPN is through **email subscription + Feishu group**. The notification path is entirely domestic and direct, pushing slot releases to your phone right away. The dashboard is just an aid.

## How it works

```
cron-job.org (every 2 minutes) ──▶ GitHub Actions
                            │  python -m quota_monitor.run
                            │  ├─ Fetch the Immigration Department's public quota API (read-only, one request at a time)
                            │  ├─ Diff against the previous snapshot → slot-release events
                            │  └─ commit data/ + refresh jsDelivr cache
                            ▼
        index.html dashboard (mobile-first, auto-refreshes every 90 seconds)
        Email + Feishu notifications (triggered by slot-release events, with debounce cooldown)
```

- API structure: [docs/api-notes.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/api-notes.md)
- 2-minute trigger configuration: [docs/cron-setup.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/cron-setup.md)

## Improvements over similar tools

- **Mobile-first:** dates scroll vertically in rows, all 6 offices fit on one screen, no horizontal table scrolling
- **Colorblind-friendly:** status cells use both color and text (available / few / full)
- **Anti-notification flooding:** the official API has load-balancing data jitter (measured: the same cell flipped between 304 and 346 within one minute), so the notification layer has a per-cell cooldown and won't fire on every cycle
- **Direct access from mainland China:** email subscription and Feishu notifications are domestically direct throughout, no VPN needed
- Light and dark themes; summary cards directly answer "what's the earliest date I can book?"

cokeenet/zve10-qemu.body:
# zve10 — Sony ZV-E10 (Gen 1 / CXD90045 "ASTRA") Reverse Engineering and Emulation Research

A collection of **interoperability research** for the **Sony ZV-E10 (ILCE-ZV-E10, CXD90045 / "ASTRA" SoC, ARMv7 soft-float)**: real-device rescue and brick prevention, firmware decryption/unpacking and system mapping, and running the original firmware in QEMU.

> **This repository contains only original glue code and research output (patches / scripts / documentation / derived data). It does not include any Sony firmware, binaries, certificates, or copies of them.** Users must export firmware from their own devices.

> 🔥 **2026-10-22 breakthrough: Line A closed the loop on real hardware.** The hardware fastboot channel is working (BootROM injection → USB fastboot → eMMC read + write). It was used on the real device to apply a 1-byte fix and recover the UI, and to locate and fix a surviving watchdog that killed sessions after about 3 min 40 s. See [`docs/FASTBOOT_EMMC.md`](https://github.com/cokeenet/zve10-qemu/blob/HEAD/docs/FASTBOOT_EMMC.md).
> 📌 **Read first next time:** [`docs/README.md`](https://github.com/cokeenet/zve10-qemu/blob/HEAD/docs/README.md) (documentation map) → [`docs/incidents/INCIDENT_20261028_LDSO_PRELOAD.md`](https://github.com/cokeenet/zve10-qemu/blob/HEAD/docs/incidents/INCIDENT_20261028_LDSO_PRELOAD.md) (**root cause of the current brick's 3-second reboot and the recovery manual**) → [`docs/STATUS_20261023.md`](https://github.com/cokeenet/zve10-qemu/blob/HEAD/docs/STATUS_20261023.md) (historical status and conclusion index).

hey8v0/ST-iPhonie.body:
# ST-iPhonie 📱

Install a little phone into your tavern.

Characters can use the phone to send you messages, call you, and post to Moments. Lines of dialogue in the narrative can be read aloud in the character's own voice. Scenes from the plot can be automatically drawn as images. You can also view the narrative as a visual novel, and when you're tired, go play a game for a while.

> Currently in beta (0.8.84). Trying it out and giving feedback is welcome. For recent changes, see 'Recent Updates' below. The full record is in **[Changelog](https://github.com/hey8v0/ST-iPhonie/blob/HEAD/更新日志.md)**.

## What it can do

### Life on the phone

- 💬 **Chat**: QQ-style private and group chats, with red envelopes, transfers, 'pat' (拍一拍), voice messages, and song sharing. You can have several chat windows open with one person. Your wallet and shop let you buy bubbles, pendants, backgrounds, and gifts to give to characters, and characters will also send you things. When you finish chatting, you can 'bring it into the story,' and the next narrative passage will pick up from there.
- 📞 **Calls**: characters call you using their own voice, with on-screen subtitles. You reply by typing. Calls you miss become missed-call entries, and they leave voicemail.
- 🌸 **Moments** and 🗨️ **Forum**: characters post updates and like and comment on each other's posts. The forum has trending topics, and characters and passing netizens post and build up threads. Things you post also get replies.
- 🔍 **Check the phone**: pick up a character's phone and look at their chats, photo album, notes, search history, and shopping cart.
- 🧠 **Memory and knowledge scope**: earlier chats are automatically condensed into summaries, and when replying, characters can recall relevant original lines. People on the phone only know what they witnessed or were told. They are not omniscient.
- 📨 **Narrative linked to the phone**: when someone in the narrative sends a message, sends a photo, transfers money, makes a call, or posts to Moments, it really shows up on the phone.

### Bringing the narrative to life

- 🔊 **Narrative voice-over**: small sound-wave icons appear next to dialogue lines. Click one to hear it read in the character's own voice. Supports Fish Audio, MiniMax, ElevenLabs, Xiaomi MiMo, and Volcano Engine Doubao speech, and can also connect to voice services you run yourself (GPT-SoVITS, etc.). There is also a dialogue mini-window, per-line listening, and a full-passage read-aloud mode that reads the narration along with the dialogue.
- 🎨 **Narrative illustrations**: use NovelAI, GPT image generation, or your own ComfyUI to pick scenes from the plot and generate images. The same character looks the same in every image. You can use Vibe to unify the art style.
- 🎬 **Visual novel**: present the narrative as a galgame. Backgrounds, character portraits, dialogue boxes, and voice-over come one line at a time. Portraits change expression and perform actions to match mood, and rain, snow, lightning, and flashbacks in the narration get staged effects.
- 🎵 **Background music and sound effects**: the plot plays background music matching each scene, and sound effects in the narrative play when they reach that point (you add the audio sources yourself).

### Play on your own

- ✨ **Assistant**: a standalone chat app that can talk about the plot, help you generate images, and run small tools.
- 🖼️ **Drawing** and 🖌️ **Painting**: Drawing uses AI to generate images. Painting is a canvas you can use with a finger or a graphics tablet, with layers, brushes, and selections. It can import Procreate and Photoshop brushes.

Spring Insight

**Lightweight APM / distributed tracing for Spring Boot.**

Lightweight distributed tracing and performance observability for Spring Boot: simple to integrate, zero-config to start, with a built-in UI. Suited to local development, integration debugging, and small-scale microservice observability.

---

## Why Spring Insight

SkyWalking, Zipkin, Micrometer Tracing and similar solutions are very capable, but integration cost is often high: collectors, storage, protocol agreements, aligning versions across multiple services...

Spring Insight is lighter:

- **Low integration cost**: add the Starter to your application and run an `insight-server` alongside it.

joylyboy/douyin-live-monitor.body:
# Douyin Live Room Start/Stop Monitor

Automatically monitors a batch of Douyin live rooms. Once a room goes live or ends its broadcast, it pushes a notification to iPhone via Bark. Tapping the notification opens the corresponding live room directly in Douyin using its URL Scheme (`snssdk1128://live`).

## How It Works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[External timer / GitHub Actions trigger] --> B[Run monitor.py]
    B --> C[Read rooms.txt]
    C --> D[Request live.douyin.com/room one by one]
    D --> E{Page contains m3u8/flv stream address?}
    E -- Yes --> F[Mark as live]
    E -- No --> G[Mark as offline]
    F & G --> H[Compare with previous state]
    H --> I[If state changed, send Bark]
    I --> J[Tap notification to open Douyin live room]
```

Detection basis: Douyin's web SSR `liveStatus` field also returns `normal` for rooms that are currently live, so it is not reliable. However, offline room pages contain zero real stream addresses such as `m3u8/flv/pull_url`, while live rooms contain many. Therefore, 'page contains real stream addresses' is used as the reliable signal for a live room. If the page cannot be fetched or an error occurs, no notification is sent in that run (to prevent false alarms).

## File Overview

- `monitor.py` — Main program: reads rooms.txt, determines live status, sends Bark notifications, and writes state.json.
- `rooms.txt` — The monitoring list. Only this file needs to be edited; monitor.py does not need to be touched.
- `state.json` — Runtime state (previous live status), automatically maintained by the program and added to .gitignore.
- `add_room.ps1` — Script for adding rooms from the local command line, independent of this tool (see below).
- `add_room.py` — Python version of the same functionality (backup).
- `.github/workflows/douyin-monitor.yml` — GitHub Actions workflow (native schedule as a fallback).

## rooms.txt Format

One room per line, in the form 'link or identifier, display name', separated by a comma:

    https://live.douyin.com/125093611494, 子成老师讲家庭教育
    https://v.douyin.com/1_AyxhJoFkc/, 羽川电商

- The display name can be omitted (short links automatically look up the nickname using the sec_uid).
- Supported formats:
  - Pure numeric room ID / Douyin ID (username)
  - `live.douyin.com/room-ID`
  - `v.douyin.com/xxxx`…

yyh-001/dsh-meme.body:
## What it can do

- **One-click image sending**: Click 😊 next to the input box, search, filter by library or mood, and click an image to send it.
- **Proactive memes**: The AI picks images on its own to match the chat mood and joins in without waiting for you. In the settings page, you can turn "AI proactively sends stickers" on or off, set the send probability (0–100%), or rewrite the prompt to adjust the style.
- **IM / mobile memes**: QQ, WeChat, Feishu, and others connected through dsh-im send stickers as native image messages, with no text markers needed. On a phone or tablet, open DSH Web through the computer's LAN IP, and turn on "LAN access to library" in the settings page to send and receive (off by default, see below). Large QQ images are easily stretched by the client as image messages. You can turn on "QQ send size" in the settings page to shrink a copy to 200–450px before sending, while Web still uses the original.
- **Learn new images**: After uploading an image, say "add this image to the library" and the AI automatically recognizes its category and description. You can also copy image files directly into the library directory and click "Scan for new" to import them in one step. For animated GIFs, this route is recommended so the original animation is kept. After files are renamed or deleted, scanning also cleans up stale records.
- **Organize the library**: Tell the AI "list the sticker inventory", "check for duplicates", or "change this to the work category." The built-in `meme_list` / `meme_update` tools handle maintenance, so you don't have to dig through the panel to change categories, descriptions, or keywords. Deletion stays in the panel to prevent accidental removal.
- **Manage and share**: Multiple library toggles, upload and edit, ZIP import/export, and marketplace install and update.
- **Works out of the box**: Includes the Dafeiyu (Big Fat Fish) library with 24 images. Core features have zero third-party runtime dependencies and use Node's built-in SQLite. QQ thumbnailing is optional: dsh-im already bundles sharp, and if it isn't installed, the original image is sent.

## Promo video

## Installation

In DSH, open **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `dsh-meme`, and install.

You can also install to a specific profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-meme
```

Requires **Node.js ≥ 22.13.0**. The old package name `dsh-expression` is deprecated; the internal plugin ID is kept for compatibility.

## Preview

You send one, and the AI replies with one.

## Library management

Open **Settings → Stickers**:

- **Library**: Cards show the image count and disk usage. Click a card to manage its images. The category dropdown filters by actual categories. "Scan for new" adopts images you copied into the directory by hand and cleans up stale records. The card toggle controls whether the AI can use that library, and you can select multiple. Supports create, import/export ZIP, submit, delete, and update.
